cards.headline:
Never signed the lease,
still lost the deposit.
foot: The court said the lease was formed at the viewing, when rent and term were settled verbally.
Hours after paying, the renter backed out.

cards.speaker: The renter (name withheld)
cards.headline: My stuff won't fit. I'm out.
foot: Nothing was signed, so they wanted the money back.

cards.speaker: Management company
cards.headline: Rent's set. The ad said 1 year.
foot: The renter's own LINE message came up too.

cards.headline:
Sent as the
“rental deposit.”

labels.context: The renter's LINE after wiring the money

foot: The renter gave this chat to the court.

cards.headline: Ruling: no refund owed
foot: The lease existed from the viewing day.
Backing out over space was on the renter.

cards.headline:
Who's to blame decides
if it's zero or double.
foot:
That's if the parties agreed nothing else.
If neither side is at fault, it's returned (item 4).
